meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 当主持人:把你的 worktree、分支或 PR 拉进一个共享 Markdown 房间,分轮让各方发言,最后产出一份合并方案(目标 worktree + 合并顺序)。全程只读,不提交不合并,再用白话向你汇报。
howto.when: 当你有多个 git worktree、分支或 PR 的改动需要比对整合时,Claude 会接管组局;可按活跃时间窗口(1h/4h/24h/7d/all)挑,也可手动指定分支与 PR。候选少于两个时它会说明并停下。

say.text: 帮我对最近 24 小时有改动的 worktree 开个 standup
say.note: 候选会先列出来让你确认再开始

say.text: 把 main 和 feature/login 这两个分支放一起比,给个合并顺序
say.note: 只读比对,产出目标与顺序

say.text: 把这次 standup 的结论用白话讲给我,列出要我拍板的决定
say.note: 清楚的选项会用 AskUserQuestion 问你

howto.what_en: Claude facilitates: it pulls your git worktrees, branches or PRs into a shared Markdown room, runs rounds, and lands on one consolidation plan — target worktree + merge order. Read-only; it then reports back in plain language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you have multiple git worktrees, branches or PRs to compare and consolidate. Claude offers a recency window (1h/4h/24h/7d/all) or lets you name branches and PRs by hand.

say_en.text: Run a standup on worktrees changed in the last 24h
say_en.note: Claude lists candidates for you to confirm

say_en.text: Compare main and feature/login, then give the merge order
say_en.note: Read-only; ends in a target + order

say_en.text: Summarize this standup in plain language and flag my calls
